original_profile.purpose: Isolate quantization with shared placement and inference settings. Pilot excluded from full study.
allowed_condition_changes: GGUF model file/path/hash; naturally resulting weight bytes
trial seed according to paired schedule; identical schedule across quantizations
original_profile.messages_policy: one exact unchanged question as one user message; no system/history/examples/tools/grammar/response_format
original_profile.question_order: random.Random(seed).shuffle(exam questions), same for every quantization
pending_before_full: User approval of final scope and concrete profile
Memory qualification of other five formats under same profile
Verify identical tokenizer/template metadata across all GGUFs
Finalize secondary reasoning-diagnostic and code-efficiency protocol before full collection
Freeze evaluator, profile and source hashes; implement/audit resumable full runner
measurement_caveats: attempt seconds includes response reception and deterministic scoring; engine timings separately retain prompt/decode times
whole-device GPU readings include desktop activity
host MemAvailable includes reclaimable mapped model pages
GPU energy monitoring began after pilot start; system energy uses rough CPU/other-component/PSU assumptions
pilot memory observations do not qualify a filled 128K context
do not assume GPU-maximized placement per format; that changes the placement-controlled protocol

placement.policy: minimum CPU expert layers qualifying at shared context; all other layers GPU; embeddings GPU; fit off

scoring.math: exact recursive JSON type/value/key/list-order equality; no numeric coercion
scoring.code: unchanged extracted fenced solve(data); all hidden tests; policy compliance; no input mutation

protocol_notes: One pass; original exam file order is identical across models.
No system prompt, examples, tools, grammar, history or answer-key exposure.
No generated code executes during inference. Coding grades pending until model shutdown.
Only model identity and CPU/GPU placement differ by quantization.
CPU/GPU package/device energy, not whole-machine wall energy. No CPU power estimates.
An interrupted generation is preserved and explicitly restarted; completed generations are never repeated.
GPU-maximized placement differs from the earlier placement-controlled pilot.

historical_deviations: Immediate code grading in original pilot; CPU energy unavailable; budget cutoff trace unavailable. Imported pilot is not a full-study condition.
